svg.title: AgentFlow durable persistence
svg.desc: Application-owned workflow run and event records coexist with LangGraph-managed checkpoint tables in PostgreSQL. A run id is reused as the LangGraph thread id for logical correlation, without a database foreign key. Checkpoints enable a new Celery task to resume after human approval.
svg.text: Operational history and resumable LangGraph state share PostgreSQL, but serve different purposes.
SQLAlchemy models · API status views · execution audit trail
PostgresSaver · pause / resume · internal checkpoint schema
The Celery task ends. PostgreSQL keeps the run status, approval events and complete LangGraph checkpoint.
On approval, a new Celery task resumes the graph by querying PostgresSaver with thread_id = run_id.
AgentFlow owns workflow_runs and workflow_events. LangGraph owns all checkpoint_* tables and their migrations.
Dashed amber line = logical correlation only · Solid teal line = application-level data relationship
